voice.name: Hank Harvey - Gruff, Rugged and Wise
voice.why: Josselin Vidal has kept the bar at the Chotain for twenty years: gruff, calm, dry, a man who counts bottles twice and says little. Hank Harvey is a calm, gruff, wise middle-aged voice. The game has male bodies only, so the barkeeper is a man (the plan's Josette became Josselin; validate-voice-sex refuses a woman's name or voice on a male body). The only American-sounding voice among the village speakers, and none of the French-accented ones (clerk, cafe owner, go-between, tally clerk, harbour master) is gruff. No other speaker uses this voice.

rumor_asked_today.text: I have told you what I know today. Ask again tomorrow.

greet.text: Evening. Beer is on the board. If you carry cartons or bottles that never saw a tax stamp, you see me, not the bar. Keep your voice down.

buy.text: Cartons and vodka, yes. Use the counter, not your mouth. Two cartons a week, a few bottles. More than that and the owner notices.

limit.text: A bar that sells ten cartons a week is a shop, and a shop gets a visit. When my shelf is full, it is full. Come back next week.

law.text: If you wear a badge, I sell beer. Nothing else, and I never saw you. Anyone else, the money is on the counter and nobody was here.

bye.text: Mind the step on your way out.

replies.ask: Do you buy cartons and vodka?
